name: The Parallel Universes Bureau
source:
A fairy lord and a noble knight threaten the fragile secrecy of the supernatural world. Can you, a seasoned field agent, maintain the peace?

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/The_Parallel_Universes_Bureau]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
一位精靈領主和一名高尚的騎士，讓超自然世界本就難以保守的秘密面臨曝光。作為一名經驗豐富的外勤特務，你能守住和平嗎？
